designations.Secretary General: Senior management — full control incl. staff, settings and final approvals
designations.President (Signatory): Signs letters and certificates; views everything else
designations.Deputy Secretary — Membership: Runs the membership desk; approves extensions, class changes, revocations
designations.Membership Officer: Reviews applications, issues temporary memberships, uploads certificates
designations.Services Officer: Handles the seven service requests up to signing
designations.Accounts Officer: Issues vouchers and verifies bank receipts
designations.Committee Secretary: Records Membership Committee decisions and minutes
designations.Front Desk / Data Entry: Enters member records and complaints; no approvals

roles.Owner: Authorized representative — everything, incl. inviting colleagues
roles.Manager: Applies, pays and manages documents; cannot manage users
roles.Services: Requests services (C.O., visa letters…) and downloads documents
roles.Accounts: Pays vouchers and uploads receipts only
